title: 第一卷 第4章 寒酸的宅子
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

程壑川吓得赶紧扶住他：“宋先生！使不得！”

“使得！”宋濂眼眶泛红，“老夫修了三年史，日思夜想就是想不通这个道理。你一来就点破了，你是老夫的贵人！”

程壑川哭笑不得。

但他心里也明白了一件事，宋濂是真正的学问人。

在这个朝不保夕的年代，还有人愿意老老实实翻书，认认真真修史。

这种人，不该死在流放的路上。

“宋先生，”程壑川扶着他坐下，“您跟我说说，陛下对这部《元史》到底有什么要求？我好有个方向。”

宋濂坐下，抹了把脸，情绪渐渐平复。

“陛下啊……”他叹了口气，“陛下要的不是一部史书，是要用元朝的灭亡来警醒后世。陛下常说，元朝以异族入主中原，不到百年就亡了，为什么？因为君臣离心，因为贪官横行，因为说真话的人都被杀了。”

“所以陛下要的《元史》，是一部亡国史，是一部教训史。”

程壑川点了点头。

他明白朱元璋的用意了。

修《元史》不是为了学术研究，是为了政治宣传。

你看，元朝就是这么亡的。

但宋濂接下来的话，让程壑川心里一动。

“不过陛下有时候也说一些别的话，”宋濂压低声音，“陛下说，元朝虽然失了天下，但它的制度有可取之处。比如行省制度，比如驿站的设置。”

“陛下还说他跟元顺帝打过仗，知道那个人不是个彻底的昏君。元顺帝最后北逃的时候，陛下还让人给他送过粮食。”

程壑川愣住了。

朱元璋给元顺帝送过粮食？这个细节他从来没见过。

宋濂似乎看出了他的疑惑，苦笑着说：“这些事情，陛下不让写进史书里。但老夫在这儿待了三年，零零碎碎听来的。”

“陛下这个人啊……”宋濂顿了顿，“杀人的时候不眨眼，但不杀人的时候，他又是个很念旧情的人。”

程壑川沉默了。

他想起了史料里的那些矛盾记载。

朱元璋一方面对元朝极尽贬低，另一方面又多次祭祀元朝皇帝。

这个人不是简单的暴君，他是一个极度复杂的人。

“宋先生，我想借您的笔记看看。”

宋濂痛快地从怀里掏出几本厚厚的册子：“都在这了。老夫记了三年，元朝每个皇帝的生平、政绩、过失，还有一些陛下的原话。”

程壑川接过来，翻开第一页。

宋濂的字迹工工整整：

“元顺帝朝，忠臣脱脱，被诬陷致死，天下冤之。脱脱死，元朝遂不可复救。”

“元顺帝朝，丞相太平，直言进谏，被毒杀。太平死，朝中再无敢言者。”

“元顺帝朝，谏官张桢，上书言十事，被贬岭南，死于贬所。从此天下只闻阿谀之声。”

Cheng Hechuan was so frightened that he quickly supported him: "Mr. Song! You can't do it!"

"Yes!" Song Lian's eyes were red, "I have been studying history for three years, and I have been thinking about it day and night but I just can't figure out this truth. You figured it out as soon as you came here, you are my noble person!"

Cheng Hechuan couldn't laugh or cry.

But he also understood one thing in his heart, Song Lian was a real scholar.

In this precarious era, there are still people who are willing to turn over books and write history conscientiously.

This kind of person should not die on the road to exile.

"Mr. Song," Cheng Hechuan helped him sit down, "please tell me what your Majesty's requirements are for this "History of the Yuan Dynasty"? I will have a direction."

Song Lian sat down, wiped his face, and gradually calmed down.

"Your Majesty..." He sighed, "What your Majesty wants is not a history book, but to use the demise of the Yuan Dynasty to warn future generations. Your Majesty often said that the Yuan Dynasty was dominated by foreign races in the Central Plains and perished in less than a hundred years. Why? Because the monarchs and ministers were alienated, because corrupt officials were rampant, and because those who told the truth were killed."

"So the "History of the Yuan Dynasty" that your Majesty wants is a history of the country's subjugation and a history of lessons."

Cheng Hechuan nodded.

He understood Zhu Yuanzhang's intention.

The "History of the Yuan Dynasty" was revised not for academic research but for political propaganda.

You see, this is how the Yuan Dynasty died.

But Song Lian's next words moved Cheng Hechuan's heart.

"But your Majesty sometimes said other things," Song Lian lowered his voice, "Your Majesty said that although the Yuan Dynasty lost the world, its system had merits. For example, the provincial system, such as the setting up of post stations."

"His Majesty also said that he had fought with Emperor Yuan Shun and knew that that man was not a complete fool. When Emperor Yuan Shun finally fled north, His Majesty even had people deliver food to him."

Cheng Hechuan was stunned.

Did Zhu Yuanzhang send food to Emperor Yuan Shun?He had never seen this detail before.

Song Lian seemed to notice his doubts and said with a wry smile: "Your Majesty will not allow these things to be written in the history books. But I have been here for three years and I have heard bits and pieces."

"Your Majesty is this person..." Song Lian paused, "He doesn't blink when he kills people, but when he doesn't kill people, he is also a person who misses old friendships."

Cheng Hechuan fell silent.

He thought of the contradictory records in historical materials.

On the one hand, Zhu Yuanzhang extremely belittled the Yuan Dynasty, and on the other hand, he sacrificed to the emperor of the Yuan Dynasty many times.

This man is not a simple tyrant, he is an extremely complex person.

"Mr. Song, I would like to borrow your notes."

Song Lian happily took out several thick booklets from his arms: "They are all here. I have been memorizing the life, political achievements, and mistakes of each emperor of the Yuan Dynasty for three years, as well as some of His Majesty's original words."

Cheng Hechuan took it and turned to the first page.

Song Lian's handwriting is neat and tidy:

"In the Yuan Shun Emperor's dynasty, Tutuo, a loyal minister, was falsely accused and died, and the world was unjust. Tutuo died, and the Yuan Dynasty could not be saved."

"In the Yuanshun Emperor's dynasty, Prime Minister Taiping was poisoned for speaking out and admonishing him. After Taiping's death, there was no one else who dared to speak out in the court."

"In the Yuan Shun Emperor's dynasty, Zhang Zhen, an admonisher, wrote a letter stating ten things. He was demoted to Lingnan and died in his exile. From then on, the world only heard the sound of flattery."
